## speed-sol2-small (hugepages): `libmimalloc-sys` with the `extended` feature

- Where: root `Cargo.toml` `[workspace.dependencies]` line 258: `libmimalloc-sys = { version = "0.1.49", default-features = false }` becomes `libmimalloc-sys = { version = "0.1.49", default-features = false, features = ["extended"] }`.
- Why: `mi_option_set_enabled` and `mi_option_large_os_pages` (libmimalloc-sys `src/extended.rs:517,583`) are behind it; lane codegen needs them to put mimalloc's segments on huge pages (the request to codegen filed beside this one; docs/v2/plan/lanes/hugepages/speed-of-light.md, "The general allocator"). No C change: the option is in the vendored mimalloc 2.3.2.
